^Share your farming, so everyone can see which maps give the most EXP for their class and level\?

Every (\d+) minutes of non-stop farming is shared: the map, your level, class and party size, and the EXP and mesos you got\. Never your character's name\.

They're combined with other players' on ([^\s]+)\. You can change this any time in Settings\.$

分享你的刷怪数据，让大家都能看到各职业、各等级在哪些地图获得经验最多？

每完成 \1 分钟的不间断刷怪就会分享一次：包含地图、你的等级、职业和队伍人数，以及获得的经验和金币。绝不包含你的角色名。

这些数据会与其他玩家的数据一起汇总在 \2。你可以随时在设置中更改。

^Also save a small picture of the whole game window\?

It shows exactly what the overlay sees, which helps a lot when something can't be found\. But it can include chat and character names, so only drag it in if you're happy with that\. It's deleted from your data folder after (\d+) minutes\.

\(No is fine: the report works without it\.\)$

是否同时保存一张游戏整个窗口的小图？

它能准确显示悬浮窗看到的内容，在找不到东西时很有帮助。但图中可能包含聊天和角色名，所以只有在你愿意的情况下才拖入。它会在 \1 分钟后从你的数据文件夹删除。
